description: November 19 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 19 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the third decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 19 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Nineteen reduces to 1, which gives November 19 a self-starting edge within Scorpio's sensitive Moon decan. The Sun at about twenty-six degrees carries emotional depth and a protective instinct, while 1 brings courage and initiative. The blend tends to describe someone who leads from conviction, often stepping forward to defend a person or cause they care about.

On November 19 the Sun usually sits at about 26° Scorpio, in the third decan, where Moon is the sub-ruler alongside Pluto. The final decan of Scorpio takes the Moon as sub-ruler, the luminary that governs Cancer. Mid-to-late November birthdays therefore blend Scorpio's depth with a strong protective and domestic instinct. Those born here are commonly described as fiercely loyal to family and close friends, sensitive to atmosphere and slow to forget either kindness or betrayal. The lunar influence can make moods shift quickly beneath a composed surface. When they feel safe, these natives tend to offer remarkably steady emotional support, the kind that stays through the difficult chapter and not just the easy one.

sections.heading: November 19 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 19 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on November 19: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 19 is the 323rd day of the year (324th in a leap year). By November 23, 4 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 19, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 19 include Indira Gandhi (1917), James A. Garfield (1831) and Jodie Foster (1962).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 19?
faq.answer: November 19 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 19 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 19?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 19 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 19?
faq.answer: November 19 is also the birthday of Indira Gandhi (1917), James A. Garfield (1831) and Jodie Foster (1962). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
